_comment: 수면 명상 채널 썸네일 소재 12편. 각 항목의 scene 이 _style.txt 와 _frame.txt 사이에 끼워져 완성 프롬프트가 된다. build 는 scripts/assets/thumb_prompt.py. ★문구는 사람이 나중에 얹는다 — 이미지에는 글자를 넣지 않는다.
_anchor_korea: Korean setting, Korean architecture and objects; NOT Western, NOT European, NOT Japanese, NOT Chinese, NOT fantasy.

_eras.joseon: Set in the Joseon dynasty of old Korea; any person wears traditional Korean hanbok; Korean tiled-roof or thatched-roof hanok architecture, period-accurate.
_eras.modern_retro: Set in Korea around the 1970s-80s; any person wears plain period Korean clothing; worn, lived-in retro Korean interiors.
_eras.modern: Set in present-day Korea; any person wears plain simple modern clothing; ordinary contemporary Korean interiors.

scenes.scene: Night rain at an old Korean mountain temple, seen from under the deep tiled eaves. Rain streams off the eave tiles and falls onto a wet stone step. On the right, a paper-screen sliding door stands half open, glowing warm amber, and just inside a folded sleeping quilt is laid out on the warm floor. The porch and stone courtyard are empty of people. Wet dark stone, mist, and heavy dark pines fill the left side in deep shadow.

A moonlit bamboo grove at deep night. A narrow earthen path curves away to the right where a small weathered stone lantern glows faint amber. Tall dark bamboo stalks fill the left side in near-black shadow, leaves catching only the faintest cool moonlight.

scenes.sound: 장작 타는 소리 + 눈 밟는 정적
scenes.scene: Inside a small Korean ondol room on a snowing night. A thick folded quilt is spread on the warm paper floor. On the right, a low brazier glows warm amber and a paper-screen window shows snow falling silently outside. The left half of the room is in deep unlit shadow.

A small Korean seaside guest room just before dawn. Bedding laid out on the floor in the foreground. On the right, an open window frames a dark sea with a faint pale horizon, and a small dim lamp sits on the sill casting warm amber. The left wall and floor fall into deep shadow.

scenes.sound: 풀벌레 + 모기장 + 먼 개 짖는 소리
scenes.scene: The wooden porch of a Korean hanok on a summer night. A person lies asleep on the porch under a thin gauze mosquito net. On the right, warm amber lamplight spills out through an open paper-screen door, and a few fireflies drift in the dark yard. The left side is deep night garden in shadow.

A small wooden Korean boat drifting on a misty lake before dawn. A single lantern hangs at the bow on the right, glowing warm amber through the fog, its reflection breaking on the still dark water. The left is open water and thick grey mist, empty and almost black.

The interior of an almost empty old Korean local train at deep night. On the right, a lone passenger sleeps leaning against the window under a dim warm ceiling light, dark countryside sliding past outside the glass. The left rows of empty seats recede into deep shadow.

An old reading room at night. On the right, a single green desk lamp pools warm light over an open book where someone has fallen asleep with their head on their arms; tall windows behind show rain running down the glass. The left rows of dark wooden desks and shelves sit in deep unlit shadow.

Seen from inside a warm Korean ondol room on the night of the first snow. The sliding door on the right stands slightly open, warm amber light spilling onto the wooden step outside where the first snow is settling. A folded quilt rests in the foreground. The left interior wall is in deep shadow.

Seen from inside a tent at night beside a mountain stream. On the right, the tent flap is open to dark trees and a faintly glinting stream, and a small camping lantern hangs glowing warm amber. A sleeping bag lies in the foreground. The left tent wall is a smooth dark surface in shadow.

The earthen courtyard of a Korean hanok on a late autumn night. On the right, an old persimmon tree still holds a few dark fruit, and warm amber light falls from an open paper-screen door onto scattered fallen leaves. The left half of the yard and the low stone wall are in deep night shadow.

A quiet bedroom at night in a Korean city apartment. On the right, rain runs down a large window; far below and out of focus, city lights blur into soft bokeh. An unmade bed sits in the dim foreground with one small warm bedside lamp. The left wall of the room is a smooth dark surface in deep shadow.
